# Commands

Console scripts from every `pyproject.toml`, and the arguments declared with `add_argument` (read statically, nothing is run).

## Console scripts

| Command | Entry point | Declared in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `repolace-eval` | `harness.cli:main` | `eval/pyproject.toml` |
| `repolace-run-task` | `repolace_pipeline.cli:main` | `pipeline/pyproject.toml` |

## `repolace-eval`

### `repolace-eval enqueue`

enqueue benchmark tasks for a run and write its manifest

| Argument | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--eval-run-id` |  |  |
| `--instances` | `'all'` | comma-separated instance ids, or 'all' |
| `--runs` | `3` | runs per instance (run_index 0..N-1) |
| `--rows` |  | comma-separated '<instance_id>#<run_index>' pairs: plan only these rows (a re-run of rows that failed outside the agent). Selects their instances; --runs must exceed the largest run index |
| `--open-pr-on-failure` |  |  |
| `--agent` | `'llm'` | recorded in the run manifest; `run` must match |
| `--model` |  | headline model id, required for --agent llm; recorded in the manifest, `run` must match |
| `--timeout-seconds` | `DEFAULT_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS` | the per-task wall clock `run` will use; recorded in the manifest, `run` must match |
| `--allow-dirty-tree` |  | record the commit sha even if tracked files are modified |
| `--instances-dir` | `DEFAULT_INSTANCES_DIR` |  |
| `--bench-repos-file` | `None` |  |
| `--runs-dir` | `DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR` |  |

### `repolace-eval fork`

create the private bench-<instance_id> repositories and push base commits (GitHub token)

| Argument | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--instances` | `'all'` | comma-separated instance ids, or 'all' |
| `--instances-dir` | `DEFAULT_INSTANCES_DIR` |  |
| `--bench-repos-file` | `None` |  |
| `--cache-dir` | `DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR` |  |
| `--add-to-installation` | `None` | also add each repository to this GitHub App installation (off by default) |
| `--delete` |  | delete the listed bench-* repositories (irreversible) |
| `--yes` |  | with --delete: actually delete instead of listing |

### `repolace-eval gold`

analyse two gold runs and write VALIDATION.md

| Argument | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--runs` | `','.join(DEFAULT_RUNS)` | the two gold run ids, comma-separated |
| `--instances-dir` | `DEFAULT_INSTANCES_DIR` |  |
| `--output` | `None` |  |
| `--runner-timeout-seconds` | `DEFAULT_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS` | the per-task wall clock the sweep will run under (default: the runner's own) |

### `repolace-eval report`

write the benchmark report from the database

| Argument | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--run` | `[]` | an agent eval run (repeatable) |
| `--gold-run` | `[]` | a gold-validation run (repeatable; id starts 'gold-') |
| `--instances-dir` | `None` | instance files, for repo and targeted-P2P data |
| `--runs-dir` | `None` | where eval/runs/<id>/manifest.json live |
| `--expect` | `None` | anchor each run to its manifest's planned grid (default: when a manifest exists); --expect requires one, --no-expect ignores them |
| `--allow-partial` |  | print a headline for an incomplete grid, marked PARTIAL |
| `--supersede` | `'none'` | duplicate (instance, run_index) rows: refuse (none, the default) or keep the newest and print what is dropped (latest) |
| `--format` | `'markdown'` |  |
| `--output` | `None` | write here instead of stdout |
| `--predictions` | `None` | also write the SWE-bench predictions JSONL here |
| `--predictions-run-index` | `None` | export only this run_index (needed when runs repeat) |

### `repolace-eval retrieval`

evaluate retrieval strategies (loads the embedding model)

| Argument | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--instances-dir` | `eval_dir / 'instances'` |  |
| `--cache-dir` | `eval_dir / 'cache'` |  |
| `--repos` | `None` | comma-separated upstream repos (default: every repo with instances) |
| `--strategies` | `list(STRATEGIES)` |  |
| `--query-strategies` | `list(QUERY_STRATEGIES)` |  |
| `--max-instances-per-repo` | `None` |  |
| `--max-chunks-per-repo` | `DEFAULT_MAX_CHUNKS_PER_REPO` |  |
| `--max-index-equivalents` | `DEFAULT_MAX_INDEX_EQUIVALENTS` |  |
| `--min-gain-pp` | `DEFAULT_MIN_GAIN_PP` | chunk-MRR gain over truncate/truncate, in percentage points, a strategy needs to meet the switch rule |
| `--plan` |  | count chunks and print the bill; embed nothing, write nothing |
| `--format` | `'markdown'` |  |
| `--output` | `None` |  |

### `repolace-eval run`

run a run's queued tasks, K at a time

| Argument | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--eval-run-id` |  |  |
| `-k, --concurrency` | `3` | subprocesses at a time (RAM: ~4 GB each) |
| `--timeout-seconds` | `DEFAULT_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS` | wall clock per task |
| `--agent` | `'llm'` |  |
| `--no-pr` |  | never open a pull request (always on for --agent gold) |
| `--model` |  | gateway model key for the agent stage (sets GATEWAY_STAGE_MODELS) |
| `--max-total-usd` | `None` | stop dispatching once the run has spent this |
| `--limit` | `None` | dispatch at most this many tasks |
| `--mark-abandoned` |  | instead of running: mark stale RUNNING rows of the run FAILED ('runner: abandoned') and exit |
| `--runs-dir` | `DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR` |  |

## `repolace-run-task`

| Argument | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` |  | the task's UUID |
| `--agent` | `DEFAULT_AGENT` | who makes the edit: the LLM agent, the deterministic plumbing stub, or the gold runner (applies a benchmark instance's reference fix, and never opens a PR) |
| `--no-pr` |  | run everything but never open a pull request, whatever the gate would decide |
